title: Template:Wikipedia-deleted/doc
content: ;Description :Use this on pages which directly use [[wikipedia:|Wikipedia]] content (that has since been deleted from Wikipedia). ;Syntax :Type {{t|wikipedia-deleted|usernames}} as the last item of the page text. :Note that "usernames" should be the known user names of the main people who edited the article ''on Wikipedia''.
